Aggregate LoanApplication {
    @identity applicationId: UUID
    applicantId: String @required
    requestedAmount: Decimal @min(1000)
    creditScore: Int @min(300) @max(850)
    status: String @default("DRAFT")
    submittedAt: DateTime?
    approvedAt: DateTime?

    invariants {
        "Status must be one of DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, WITHDRAWN": status in ["DRAFT", "SUBMITTED", "APPROVED", "REJECTED", "WITHDRAWN"]
    }

    operations {
        when submitting application with submittedAt:
            require that:
                - applicantId is required
                - requestedAmount is required
                - creditScore is required
                - status is "DRAFT"
            then:
                - set status to "SUBMITTED"
                - set submittedAt to submittedAt
            emit LoanApplicationSubmitted with applicationId, submittedAt

        when approving application with approvedAt:
            require that:
                - status is "SUBMITTED"
                - creditScore > 650
                - requestedAmount > 0
            then:
                - set status to "APPROVED"
                - set approvedAt to approvedAt
            emit LoanApplicationApproved with applicationId, approvedAt
    }
}
